findings.description: The cycle guard (`seen` set of visited exception ids) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk, so a cyclic cause chain now loops forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose `__cause__` chain loops back (e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, which Python allows by direct assignment) and which matches no `exception_cause_types`. Mechanism: `while exc is not None` never terminates because `exc = exc.__cause__` keeps cycling. Impact: the retry predicate hangs, blocking the caller indefinitely at 100% CPU.
